ambiguities_or_notes: The French original is translated directly and the following editorial Russian rendering is translated independently; deliberate duplication is retained.
The French code-switch староста and Russian italic староста are both represented as italic starosta rather than silently substituting village elder.
600 р. асс. is rendered 600 rubles in assignats, preserving the historical paper-money denomination.
The direct French uses Basile and Pauline; the editorial Russian uses Vasenka and Polina. Those distinct source forms are kept rather than harmonized.
All ten footnotes are translated, including the duplicated explanatory notes attached separately to the French and Russian renderings.
The queried Tula location in the printed heading remains Tula? rather than being regularized to a certain location.
